scope: ADR-0090 / #129: .gitattributes `* text=auto` -> `* text=auto eol=lf` so every text file checks out as LF on every platform, fixing CRLF in 322 of 326 .claude/skills files on a Windows checkout. The blobs are already LF (index i/lf for all 326), so this changes only the working-tree checkout - no 322-file content diff, no spurious git status mods, no sha/provenance change. Verdict recorded below.

boundary.evidence: .gitattributes is the layer that governs checkout line endings - the correct place for this fix; the fix is a single attribute addition.

ownership.evidence: the committed .gitattributes is the single owner of checkout attributes; blobs stay LF (text=auto keeps normalization), eol=lf only sets checkout.

dependency.evidence: n/a - static config; binary files are auto-detected by text=auto and eol does not apply to them.

error-handling.evidence: n/a - config; the discrimination test fails closed if eol=lf is dropped (check-attr would report unspecified).

ownership.evidence: n/a - asks git itself (check-attr eol) for the resolved attribute, binding to the real behavior.

dependency.evidence: n/a - pure node + git; skips if git is unavailable.

error-handling.evidence: asserts eol resolves to lf for representative skill/doc/json/script files; dropping eol=lf makes git report unspecified and fails these.
